versions.subject: Create proc_creation_macos_enable_guest_account.yml (#4054)
versions.detection:
selection:
    Image|endswith: '/sysadminctl'
    CommandLine|contains|all:
        # By default the guest account is not active
        - ' -guestAccount'
        - ' on'
condition: selection
